Question B-001-019-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Below 148 MHz, amateur station frequency stability must be equivalent to crystal control.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "It shall remain within 2 parts per million, one hour after power up": This gives a parts-per-million warm-up specification, while the requirement below 148 MHz is equivalence to crystal control.
- sourceIndex 2: "It must not drift more than 10 Hz from a governmental time signal broadcast service": A drift comparison to a time-signal broadcast is a different reference idea, not the crystal-control equivalence standard.
- sourceIndex 3: "It shall remain within 0.05% from -30 to +40 degrees Celsius ambient temperature": This is a temperature-tolerance style specification; the amateur stability requirement is stated instead as crystal-control equivalence below 148 MHz.
